full_judgment: This revisional application under section 115 (3) of the Code of Civil Procedure is directed against the order dated 8.1.1985 passed by the Additional District Judge, Rajshahi in Civil Revision Case No.42 of 1982 filed by the opposite party Nos. 1-3 reversing the order dated 7.6.82 passed by the Munsif (Sadar), Rajshahi in Other Suit No.240 of 1973 by which the prayer of the opposite parties for the appointment of an Advocate Commissioner for holding local investigation was allowed. Opposite party Nos. 1-3 as plaintiffs instituted a suit bearing other suit No.240 of 1973 on 4.3.73 in the court of Munsif (Sadar), Rajshahi with a prayer for declaration of Title and recovery of possession of the suit land in CS Plot Nos.3227 in CS Khatian No.491 and also prayed for permanent injunction. The petitioner as the defendant contested the suit by filing written statement denying the claim of the plaintiffs and asserting their right, title, interest and possession in plot Nos.3227 and 3229 of CS Khatian No.491. Claims and counter claims made by the plaintiffs and the defendant in the suit necessitated the appointment of survey knowing commissioner for the relayment of the disputed land. Accordingly, the plaintiff opposite party Nos. 1-3 prayed for holding local investigation on 4.12.73 and Advocate Commissioner being appointed, held local investigation in the suit lands and submitted his report on 24.2.75. The defendant petitioner filed objection against the report of the learned Advocate Commissioner and also prayed for holding further investigation on 8.7.75. After hearing the objection was rejected and the Advocate Commissioner's report was accepted by the learned court on 22.1.1976. Thereafter the defendant petitioner prayed for the appointment of another Advocate Commissioner for measuring, relaying and ascertaining the actual length and breadth of CS. Plot No.3227 and CS Plot No.3229 and also to ascertain in which plot the alleged latrine, wall and urinal situate and the learned Munsif after hearing the matter rejected the prayer on 5.12.79 of the defendant petitioner for holding further commission as it was considered that there was no necessity for further com-mission on the same points which arc available from the report of the local investigation held earlier.
